assumptions: CLI `psnrhvs-y` -> psnrhvs_luma8 (lib.rs:465): BT.601 luma gray_px (lib.rs:578, round(0.299R+0.587G+0.114B)) widened to f32 plane, then plane_step_impl step=8 non-overlapping 8x8 blocks (lib.rs:307-355). NOT the daala fixed-point path (that is psnrhvs-daala).
Per block: orthonormal f32 DCT-II 8x8 via separable matmul T (kernel.rs:49-52,300-321): 8 rows x 8 outs x 8 fma + 8 cols x 8 outs x 8 fma = 1024 fma per image.

maskeff per image (kernel.rs:322-370): e = sum_{c!=0} dct^2*MaskCof (63 fma + 63 mul... counted 63 mul + 63 add as fma-folded), whole-block variance (64 add + div + 64 sub/fma + div + mul), 4 quadrant variances (each 16 add + div + 16 sub/fma + div), quadsum/div/blend, sqrt, /32.
Coefficient loop (kernel.rs:374-395): DC unmasked; c=1..63: u=|da-db|, t2=u*csf -> s2+=t2^2; thr=mask/MaskCof; um=max(0,u-thr); s1+= (um*csf)^2. ~8 flops + 1 div per coef.
Block sums folded to f64 totals (2 cvt+add per block); finalize = 10*log10(255^2/mean) x2 (lib.rs:248-268).
SIMD batches process LANES blocks at once; scalar semantics counted per block. Block grid NB = floor((w-8)/8+1)*floor((h-8)/8+1).

stages.name: separable f32 DCT-II 8x8, both blocks
stages.notes: Per block: 2 imgs x (64 fma row pass + 64 fma... ) = 2x1024 fma. Block loads 64 px each img.

stages.name: masking threshold e/pop/variance -> block mask
stages.notes: Per image-block: e sum 63mul+63add, var 64add+div+64(sub+fma=2ops)+div+mul, 4 quads x ~50, fold ~10 -> ~600 add-equiv + 135 mul + 7 div + sqrt. x2 images.

stages.name: masked/unmasked coefficient energy sums
stages.notes: Per coef (64): |da-db| (add+abs), t2=u*cv mul + acc add; c>=1: thr=mask/mv div, max cmp, t1 mul + acc.

stages.name: f64 fold + 10*log10 finalize
stages.notes: Per block: 2 cvt + 2 f64 adds (maps skipped). Finalize once: ~10 flops + log10.
